findings.summary: The path traversal check uses startswith(base) without a trailing separator, so a sibling directory like /tmp/out2 passes for base /tmp/out; the same flaw is in the zip, rar, 7z and tar (line 108) code.
The rar symlink check unpacks info.file_redir as a 3-tuple, but it is None for RAR3 archives where is_symlink() is true, raising TypeError.

If all 7z members are blocked, targets is empty and extract(targets=[]) may extract everything, including blocked paths; also name-based filtering could extract a blocked file sharing a name with an allowed one.
The 7z badlink helper is never called and there are commented-out symlink blocks (dead code).
Blocked members are only logged with logger.error, so extraction reports success with files silently missing; it should raise or at least warn.
list[zipfile.ZipInfo] annotations at lines 190, 243 and 319 are evaluated at import time and break on Python 3.8.
